name: AM-087
summary: AM-087 (part of the AM cannabinoid series) is an analgesic drug which acts as a cannabinoid agonist. It is a derivative of Δ8-THC, substituted on the 3-position side chain.43 nM, making it around 100 times more potent than THC itself. This is most likely due to the bulky bromine substituent on the side chain.

pharmacology.text: AM-087 (part of the AM cannabinoid series) is an analgesic drug which acts as a cannabinoid agonist. AM-087 is a potent CB1 agonist with a Ki of 0.43 nM, making it around 100 times more potent than THC itself.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the cannabinoid receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究大麻素受體的研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究大麻素受体的研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Potent synthetic cannabinoids as a class can cause a racing heart, anxiety, confusion, vomiting and, at times, psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。強效合成大麻素作為一類，可能造成心跳急促、焦慮、混亂、嘔吐，有時還會引發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。强效合成大麻素作为一类，可能造成心跳急促、焦虑、混乱、呕吐，有时还会引发精神病。

fact.en: The AM codes come from Alexandros Makriyannis, the chemist at the University of Connecticut and later Northeastern University whose laboratory made this long series of cannabinoid compounds.
fact.zh: AM 系列的代號來自 Alexandros Makriyannis，這位化學家先後任職於康乃狄克大學與東北大學，他的實驗室合成了這一長串大麻素化合物。
fact.zhHans: AM 系列的代号来自 Alexandros Makriyannis，这位化学家先后任职于康乃狄克大学与东北大学，他的实验室合成了这一长串大麻素化合物。
